snippet.title: পরিবেশ বাঁচাতে গাছের পাতার প্লেট কীভাবে বানানো হয়? দেখুন আসল প্রক্রিয়া
snippet.description:
​আজকের ভিডিওতে আমরা দেখবো কীভাবে জঙ্গল ও গ্রামীণ প্রান্ত থেকে সংগৃহীত শাল গাছের পাতা দিয়ে পরিবেশবান্ধব প্লেট তৈরি করা হয়। প্লাস্টিকের ক্ষতিকর দিকের বিকল্প হিসেবে এই পাতার প্লেট পরিবেশ ও স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য কতটা উপকারী, তার পাশাপাশি কাঁচা পাতা সংগ্রহ, কাঠি দিয়ে জোড়া দেওয়া, রোদে শুকানো, ‘BROTHER’ সেলাই মেশিনে সেলাই, হিট-প্রেস মেশিনে মোল্ডিং, ধারালো দা দিয়ে বাড়তি অংশ কেটে সমান করা এবং পলিথিনে বান্ডিল করে প্যাকিং করার পুরো বাস্তব প্রক্রিয়াটি তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

​এই ভিডিওতে যা যা থাকছে:

​প্লাস্টিকের ক্ষতিকর দিক ও পরিবেশবান্ধব পাতার প্লেটের গুরুত্ব

​জঙ্গল থেকে শাল পাতা সংগ্রহ, বস্তায় ভরে আনা ও চিকন কাঠি দিয়ে জোড়া দেওয়া

​রোদে শুকানো, সেলাই মেশিনে সেলাই ও হিট-প্রেস মেশিনে প্লেটের আকার দেওয়া

​বাড়তি অংশ কেটে মসৃণ করা ও পলিথিনে বান্ডিল করে বাজারজাত করার প্রস্তুতি

​প্লাস্টিকের বিকল্পে এমন পরিবেশবান্ধব কাজ আর গ্রামীণ শ্রমজীবী মানুষের পরিশ্রম আপনাদের কেমন লাগলো তা কমেন্টে জানান। ভিডিওটি ভালো লাগলে লাইক ও শেয়ার করুন, আর এমন আরও বাস্তব কাজের ভিডিও দেখতে চ্যানেলটি সাবস্ক্রাইব করে পাশে থাকুন!

snippet.description:
スコップ1本から本物の「擁壁」ができるまで

坂の土地を掘って平らにすれば、マイホームの完成…と思いきや 🏠
実は坂を平らにするには、土の重さ・地盤のやわらかさ・雨水と戦う工夫がいくつも必要なんです。

掘ったそばから土が崩れて生き埋めに。先に鉄の杭を打ち、掘りながら板をはめていく「土留め」🪵
木の板では坂の土に押し負けるので、鉄筋のかごにコンクリートを流し込んだ「擁壁」🧱 高さ3m・幅10mの壁にかかる力は車20台分！
重い壁がやわらかい土に沈まないよう、割った石を敷きつめて突き固める「割栗石」🪨
まっすぐな壁は押されて倒れるので、足を土の下まで伸ばし、上の土を重しにする「かかと版」🦶
埋め戻した土はふかふかで家が傾く…そこで鉄のパイプをかたい地盤までねじ込む「鋼管杭」🔩

擁壁にポツポツあいている穴は手抜きではありません。裏にたまった雨水を逃がす「水抜き穴」で、ふさぐと押す力は車50台分に💧
仕上げにウッドデッキとパラソル、帰りの坂で動かなくなる柴犬を添えれば、坂の上のマイホーム完成です🐕

snippet.title: Why You See Colours When You Rub Your Eyes #shorts
snippet.description:
When you rub your closed eyes, the pressure squashes the cells at the back of your eye. They can't tell a push from real light, so they fire anyway, and your brain reads that signal as light. That's why you see colours, spots, checkerboards or spirals with your eyes shut. Doctors call these pressure phosphenes. But rubbing also makes your eye release histamine, which makes it itch more, so you rub again. Be gentle with them.

snippet.title: 반도체주·앤트로픽 '급락' 직격탄 맞았다..미 증시 '폭락' / SBS
snippet.description:
〈앵커〉

간밤에 미국 증시가 폭락했습니다. 미국 최대 기업공개 실적을 거둔 앤트로픽과 엔비디아, AMD 등 반도체주가 직격탄을 맞은 건데요. AI 투자에 대한 불안이 커졌다는 분석이 나오는데, 트럼프 대통령은 미국 기업이 데이터센터를 외국에 지으면 엄청난 세금을 물리겠다고도 했습니다.

보도에 민경호 기자입니다.

〈기자〉

클로드 개발사의 미국 최대 기업공개도 AI 투자 심리를 되살리지 못했습니다.

앤트로픽은 나스닥 상장 첫날 17% 올라 마감했지만 오늘(21일)만 8.57% 폭락했습니다.

시간으로만 따지면 첫날 상장 20분 이후로는 끝없는 내리막이었고, 오늘 장중 한때는 공모가 83달러를 위협하기도 했습니다.

미국 반도체 기업들을 묶은 필라델피아지수가 10% 넘게 하락했고, 이른바 서학개미가 가장 많이 사들인 미국 반도체 기업 하루 수익률 3배 추종 ETF '속슬'은 30% 넘게 폭락했습니다.

나스닥도 5% 이상, S&P500 지수도 3% 이상 빠졌습니다.

AI 인프라 투자가 수익성이 있는지에 대한 의구심이 시장에서 여전히 해결되지 않는 건데, 리사 쿡 연준 이사는 현재 미국 금리가 물가 상승세를 통제할 만큼 충분히 높지 않다는 발언을 내놨습니다.

다음 달 미국 연준이 기준금리를 올릴 확률은 현재 98.2%까지 치솟았는데, 빚내서 투자를 지속해 온 AI 업계에 부담되는 소식입니다.

미국 기업이 외국에 데이터센터를 지을 경우 세금을 물리겠다는 트럼프 대통령의 발언도 달갑잖습니다.

데이터센터 전력 비용을 주변에 전가하지 않고 직접 부담하도록 하는 법안이 상원을 통과한 데 대해 언급하다 나온 발언인데, 시장 불확실성만 키웠다는 평가가 나옵니다.

[도널드 트럼프/미국 대통령 : 기업들이 다른 나라에 데이터센터를 짓는 걸 두고 보지 않겠습니다. 그럴 수도 있겠지만, 만약 그렇게 한다면 엄청난 세금을 물릴 겁니다.]

미국 나스닥에 상장된 SK하이닉스 ADR 역시 14% 가까이 폭락해 주말을 지난 뒤 우리 증시에도 적잖은 영향이 이어질 것으로 보입니다.

snippet.title: A peça mais odiada da F1 salvou várias vidas
snippet.description:
Uns 7 kg de titânio. O Hamilton chamou de "a modificação mais feia da história da Fórmula 1". O chefe da Mercedes queria arrancar com uma motosserra. Anos depois, essa peça segurou o Red Bull do Verstappen em cima da cabeça do próprio Hamilton, em Monza.

Começa na Hungria, em 2009: uma mola do carro do Rubinho acerta o capacete do Felipe Massa a mais de 250 km/h. A FIA vai atrás de um jeito de proteger a cabeça e testa de tudo: cúpula de caça (uma estilhaçou no tiro de pneu, a outra envergou demais), a tela da Red Bull em 2016 e o escudo da Ferrari em 2017, que deixou o Vettel tonto. Sobrou o halo.

Pra mim, segurança é inegociável, e hoje o halo parece parte natural do carro. E pra você: o próximo passo é tela, como na Indy, ou o halo já basta? 👇

▸ Halo: titânio, ≈ 7 kg, aguenta 125 kN de cima (≈ 12 toneladas, um ônibus de dois andares)
▸ Spa 2018: o McLaren do Alonso passa por cima do Sauber do Leclerc; a asa ia na viseira e bateu no halo
▸ Bahrein 2020: Grosjean no guard-rail a 192 km/h e 67 g; o carro se parte e pega fogo; ele sai andando, com queimaduras nas mãos
▸ Monza 2021: a roda do Red Bull para em cima da cabeça do Hamilton. "Salvou o meu pescoço"
▸ Silverstone 2022: o Zhou capota e desliza de cabeça pra baixo; o santo antônio cede, o halo não
▸ Indy: a tela recusada pela F1 virou regra em 2020, sobre uma estrutura de titânio

snippet.title: Spectator Cool Feature in Dandy's world 1.0 #dandysworld #roblox #update
snippet.description:
#robloxtrend #robloxshorts #dandysworldroblox #dandysworldmeme #speed

Dandy's World has now left Alpha! Version 1.0 opens The Labs, a brand new game mode with new Floors, new Lethal Twisteds, Lab Cards and so much more!

New game mode: The Labs
2 new shopkeepers: Dioda & Dessa
2 new Lethal Twisteds added: Twisted Dessa & Twisted Dioda
 These two new Lethals only appear in The Labs
- 11 new Floors added within The Labs, plus a new Labs Break Room
- New Lab Cards to collect, equip and bring them into The Labs
- New currency: Ambrosia
- Nothing has been reset for 1.0: your Ichor, Toons, skins, trinkets, stickers, titles, research and mastery all carry over
- +1 Sticker Wheel (8 more sticker slots) added for members of the BlushCrunch Studio Roblox group
- The Alpha Player badge can no longer be earned
- All players who earned the Alpha Player badge receive a unique achievement, the "Alpha Player" title, 500 Ambrosia, 2 Ambrosia Vials and the "Welcome to Dandy's World! (Instrumental)" Profile Sound!
  - Redeem your reward from VeeMail or your Journal

- 4 new items in The Labs
  - *Extra Heart**: *Adds a bonus heart that absorbs your next hit. Stacks
  - *Alarm Clock**: *Rings for 8 seconds, attracting Twisteds until it stops
  - *Glitter Glue**: *Drops a glue puddle that lasts for 60s. Grants +75% Extraction Speed but also Slowness 1. Lasts for 5 seconds after leaving the puddle. Only affects whoever placed it
  - **Ambrosia Heart**: Received as a reward from Dessa’s Experiments, use this in the Reanimator in the elevator to bring back a teammate who has been Lost
- Ambrosia Vials let you reanimate yourself once per Labs run. They can be purchased from Dioda in the Lobby. They are not available for purchase in Game, so come prepared
- A Toon who becomes Lost in The Labs drops all of their items for the team to pick up
- Each Floor in The Labs has 1 more machine to complete than a Gardenview Run
- Ichor earnings are slightly lower in The Labs compared to normal Gardenview Runs
- 100+ new Toon-to-Toon conversations that only happen in The Labs
- New settings for The Labs: Labs Effects, Dessa Colors (with a color-blind safe option), Dessa Labels, and Dessa Outlines
